notes: USDA food code is a reference code; best stored as a concept in the OMOP vocabulary. A new concept would need to be created with this code as concept_code and appropriate domain (e.g., Observation) and vocabulary (e.g., USDA_FOOD).
Food Code Short Description is the human‑readable name for the USDA food code. It maps to the concept_name field of the same concept created for DRXFDCD.

Food Code Long Description provides a more detailed description of the USDA food code. It can be stored as an alternate concept_name or as a separate concept with a longer name, linked to the same concept_id as DRXFDCD.
